app.name: Bonfire
app.tagline: Game save backup with version history
ui.placeholder: The core library is under development; the UI arrives in M3.
cli.cmd.root: Bonfire: game save backup with version history
cli.cmd.game.add: Add a game manually (save folder or file)
cli.cmd.game.rm: Remove a game: manual games are deleted, discovered ones are ignored (snapshots stay)
cli.cmd.scan: Discover games on Steam/Epic/GOG and detect changes of all games
cli.cmd.status: Show game status; lists changed files for one game
cli.cmd.diff: Compare two snapshots, or a snapshot with the disk
cli.cmd.branch: Create a branch; lists branches and tags without a name
cli.cmd.tag: Create a tag (never cleaned up); lists without a name
cli.cmd.reindex: Rebuild the index database from the repository
cli.arg.game.add.name: Game name
cli.arg.game.add.install_dir: Install folder, used to detect a running game
cli.arg.scan.force_verify: Ignore metadata and rehash every file
cli.arg.status.force_verify: Ignore metadata and rehash every file
cli.arg.backup.message: Snapshot comment (max 500 chars); generated when omitted
cli.arg.backup.profile: Use the games of a profile
cli.arg.backup.force: Create a snapshot even without changes
cli.arg.backup.all: Back up every game that changed or was never backed up
cli.arg.backup.new_branch: Name of the new branch after restoring an old snapshot
cli.arg.backup.move_branch: Move the current branch instead of creating one after a restore
cli.arg.diff.b: Snapshot B; compares with the disk when omitted
cli.arg.restore.target: Snapshot to restore (HEAD~1, tag, branch, hash prefix)
cli.arg.restore.full: Full restore: also delete files not in the snapshot
cli.arg.restore.force: Restore even if the game is running
cli.arg.ref.name: Name; lists when omitted
cli.arg.profile.name: Profile name
cli.arg.fsck.deep: Rebuild every file and verify its hash (slower)
cli.out.no_games: No games yet. Add one with: bonfire game add <name> --path <save folder>
cli.out.game_removed: Removed "{name}"; its snapshots stay in the repository
cli.out.restore_plan: Will overwrite {overwrite}, create {create}, delete {delete} files; {unchanged} identical
cli.out.protection: Created protection snapshot {id}; undo with bonfire undo-restore
cli.out.fsck_ok: Repository OK: {chunks} chunks, {blobs} files, {trees} trees, {snapshots} snapshots, {refs} refs
cli.out.fsck_tmp: {n} temporary files left by interrupted writes
cli.error.need_yes: Pass --yes to confirm in a non-interactive session
cli.cmd.game.confirm: Confirm heuristically found save locations (saved as a custom rule)
cli.arg.scan.platform: Only scan one platform: steam / epic / gog
cli.arg.scan.no_discover: Skip platform discovery, only detect changes
cli.arg.rules.update.bundle: Also write a bundled snapshot (for packaging)
cli.out.discovered: Platforms: {platforms}; {found} games with saves ({added} new), {nosave} installed games without saves
cli.out.unconfirmed: "{name}" has {n} guessed save locations to confirm: bonfire game confirm {name}
cli.out.no_rules: No rules downloaded yet; run bonfire rules update
cli.out.game_ignored: Ignored "{name}"; it won't be re-added. Undo with bonfire game enable
cli.cmd.info: Show or edit game info (name, cover, developer, playtime…)
cli.arg.info.set: Edit and lock a field: name / nameZh / developer / publisher / releaseDate / cover (image path)
cli.arg.info.unlock: Unlock a field for automatic refresh
cli.arg.info.search: Search candidates by name (needs an IGDB or SteamGridDB key)
cli.out.no_candidates: No candidates (set an IGDB or SteamGridDB API key)
cli.out.no_metadata: No info yet; run a scan or bonfire info <game> --refresh
